scope: Synthetic envelopes with exactly known marginal Rayleigh distributions, not RF acquisitions. IID pixels and 4x4 constant tiles offset by two pixels. Fixed mask and origin. Each trial is independently generated; same field across block sizes. Coverage means interval contains the population metric. Continuous gCNR truth is compared to the existing adaptive 64-bin estimator, retaining histogram bias.
limitations: Finite Monte Carlo precision is quantified with Wilson intervals. No clinical coverage guarantee or automatic correction factor. Tile model is not a tissue model; ROI selection, paired changes and other correlation structures are untested. No block size is selected from these trials.
